goal: Look up member 1****. Read the member's name and bind it to output 'memberName'. Read the current savings balance and bind it to output 'savingsBalance'. Then open a new savings sub-account with a 500 dollar opening deposit and reach the review screen. Do not click Create Account.

intent: Enter the member ID 1**** into the search field
Click Search button to find member 1****
expectedEffect: The member details for member 1**** will be displayed
The member name "J****" will be bound to output 'memberName'
The savings balance "$****" will be bound to output 'savingsBalance'

intent: Click 'Open New Account' to begin opening a new savings sub-account
expectedEffect: A form for opening a new account will be displayed
The account type dropdown will show 'Savings' as selected

intent: Enter 500 as the opening deposit amount
expectedEffect: The opening deposit textbox will contain "500"

intent: Click 'Continue to Review' to proceed to the review screen
expectedEffect: The review screen will be displayed with the new account details
